note: Felles stil for alt som genereres (content/assets.json). Hvert bilde bestilles som: style.prompt + framing for sin type + beskrivelsen av motivet. Endres stilen, øk version: bilder laget med en eldre versjon kan da finnes og lages på nytt. Se content/README.md.

style.about: Varm, rolig billedbokstil for barn 5–7 år. Monstrene er rare og litt tøysete, aldri skumle. Alt skal kunne kjennes igjen i liten størrelse på en iPad.
style.prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, warm muted palette with a few clear accent colours, gentle rounded shapes, clean readable silhouette, friendly expressive faces, soft even light, simple shading. Whimsical Nordic fairy-tale mood, curious and cosy, never scary. Single subject, centred, fully visible, plain transparent background, no text, no letters, no frame, no border.
style.avoid: scary, gore, blood, sharp teeth close-up, horror, realistic photo, 3D render, text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, busy background, multiple subjects, cropped subject

framing.figure: A full-body character, standing or sitting, facing the viewer slightly turned.
framing.item: A single object, slightly from above, like a sticker.
framing.obstacle: A small scene of the obstacle in a cave passage, seen from the front.
framing.source: A small scene of the place in a cave, the source clearly visible.
framing.recipe: A single crafted object, slightly from above, like a sticker.
framing.tag: A very simple symbol for the idea, bold and flat, readable at 32 pixels.
framing.mission: The goal of an adventure, shown as a single important thing or character.
framing.theme: A single thing or character, like a sticker.
framing.generic: A very simple symbol, bold and flat, readable at 32 pixels.
